name: repo_clone
title: repo.clone
description: Clone a public repository in full. Shallow clones are refused: blame and SZZ require complete history.

refresh.description: Re-fetch if already cloned. Default false.

outputSchema.description: Describes the `data` payload ONLY. The envelope { ok, evidenceId, data | unknown } is universal and enforced by modules/mcpserver.

refreshed.description: Present only when refresh was requested on an EXISTING clone. False means the fetch failed and the clone is stale but usable — see refreshError.

refsUpdated.description: Refs the fetch moved. 0 means already current.

refreshError.description: Why the fetch failed. A stale clone still answers every historical question, so this is reported rather than fatal.
